question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 F 组：荷兰 vs 日本（6 月 14 日），90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group F: Netherlands vs Japan (June 14) — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 荷兰纸面略优但后防门将伤情叠加，状态火热的日本足以把首战拖入接近五五开的胶着局面。
one_liner_en: The Netherlands edge it on paper, but with defensive and keeper injuries an in-form Japan can drag the opener close to a coin flip.

key_reasons.cn: 荷兰后卫 Timber 因伤退出世界杯，主力门将 Verbruggen 缺席 6 月 10 日训练、出战成疑
key_reasons.en: Netherlands defender Timber ruled out of the World Cup; first-choice keeper Verbruggen missed June 10 training and is a doubt

key_reasons.cn: 日本核心边锋三笘薰因腿筋伤势落选最终名单，但队长远藤航伤愈复出、中场骨架完整
key_reasons.en: Japan lose key winger Mitoma (hamstring) from the final squad, but captain Endo is back fit and the midfield spine is intact

key_reasons.cn: Elo 仅差 42 分（荷兰 1948 vs 日本 1906），中立闭顶场馆，统计基线本就接近均势
key_reasons.en: Only a 42-point Elo gap (NED 1948 vs JPN 1906) at a neutral climate-controlled venue — the statistical baseline is already near-even

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gives p_stat NED 41.6%/draw 25.8%/JPN 32.6%; bounded evidence adjustment of 3pp (NED -3, draw +1, JPN +2) for Dutch defensive/keeper injuries vs Japan's better availability; renormalized. No market prices used anywhere.
